title: Manager lists every git worktree of each open project: size, dirty, remove
notes: The manager's worktree rows came only from worktrees.json, so worktrees made outside a ship (agent sessions, hand-made, .claude/worktrees) never showed. List every linked worktree git knows for each open project, with its size on disk, dirty or clean, and a remove key.

comments.body: Shipped in #67: manager scans git for every worktree of each open project, with dirty state, size (du, one at a time, every 5 min) and removal of unrecorded ones. Tests 1021 pass; real scan on new-crm finds all 19.
